name: Флорипа по-русски (floripa.info)
outsideFamily: floripa.info is a family member on its own domain; it stays out of FAMILY_DOMAINS, which would also make it a resource any self-registered or public client may bind a token to

overrides.reason: the floripa-bot portal (Python, bot/api/inite_auth.py) signs in as a public PKCE client: no secret, no refresh, callback at /api/auth/inite/callback, not @inite/auth
